During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] constructed a '''large base''' on [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]]. It was later the focal point of a [[Battle of Boz Pity (Clone Wars)|battle]] between the Confederacy and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].
